_comment: SYNTHETIC — hand-written test data, NOT a capture and NOT a real Fantasy Nerds response. Fantasy Nerds publishes NO response schema (https://api.fantasynerds.com/docs/nfl lists endpoints + the apikey parameter only), so this envelope and these field names are an ASSUMED shape built from the stat categories on the public weekly page (https://www.fantasynerds.com/nfl/weekly-projections, retrieved 2026-09-25). It exercises the parser's contract, not the provider's real wire format. The ambiguous fields 'fumbles' and 'tackles' are here on purpose to prove they stay unmapped. Numbers and playerIds are invented; no API key was used.
